_comment: Single source of truth for version pins, ports, paths, and defaults shared across the npm and Docker install paths. Read by scripts/dev-safe.mjs, scripts/dev-with-automation.mjs, docker/entrypoint.sh (via generated defaults.env), and .github/workflows/docker.yml.

constraints._comment: Temporary upper bound on the agent-client-protocol (acp) transitive dependency. openhands-sdk 1.35.0 requires agent-client-protocol>=0.10.1 with no upper bound, but acp 0.11.0 reordered the ACP prompt() arguments and breaks the SDK's ACP client (a PromptRequest validation error surfaces as 'ACP error: 2 validation errors for PromptRequest'). Pin acp <0.11 until a fixed openhands-sdk ships. Consumed by scripts/dev-safe.mjs (agent-server uvx install) and .github/workflows/mock-llm-e2e.yml (mock ACP server venv). fastapi: FastAPI 0.153-0.156 (all released 2026-10-20) dropped the deprecated `lte=` alias that openhands-agent-server 1.42.1's bash_router still passes to Query(), so a fresh uvx resolve crashed on import (`TypeError: Query() got an unexpected keyword argument 'lte'`). Pin fastapi <0.153 until an agent-server release uses `le=`. fastmcp: 4.1.3 (2026-10-21) started reading an MCP server's `timeout` as milliseconds (it was ignored before), so any server configured with a timeout in seconds -- the convention in OpenHands MCP settings -- gets a sub-second request budget and conversation creation fails with `Request 'tools/list' timed out`. Pin fastmcp <4.1.3 until the SDK converts seconds to milliseconds.

desktop._comment: Electron desktop shell. remoteAppUrl is the hosted web app the app loads in its default (remote) mode; githubRepo is where 'Check for Updates' looks for releases. Override the URL at runtime with NEO_DESKTOP_REMOTE_URL.
